declare

 -- Added by Kishore on 9/19/2013. IM 9525

 :global.error_count := 'N'; -- This is used in the on-error trigger
 -- End of change

 nullchk;

 else

 next_item;

 end if;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: LBL_AG_PRINT

PACKAGE BODY LBL_AG_PRINT IS
 PROCEDURE VALIDATE_PRODUCT_TYPE IS
 t_dummy VARCHAR2(1);
 BEGIN
 :ctrl_blk_6.charsave := :lbl_ag_print_prod_types.product_type;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_6.match_found > 1 then
 show_error('2108');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 select distinct 'x'
 into t_dummy
 from valid_product_types
 where product_type_code = :LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.product_type
 and product_type_code = nvl(:ctrl_blk_6.s_product_type, :LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.product_type) 
 and :ctrl_blk_6.chp_sysdate
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_blk_6.chp_sysdate + 10);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1245');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END validate_product_type;
 
 PROCEDURE VALIDATE_EFF_DATE IS
 v_sysdate date;
 t_eff_date date;
 BEGIN
 default_value(null, 'global.error_count');
 :global.error_count := 'N'; -- This is used in the on-error trigger

 
 if :lbl_ag_print_prod_types.eff_date is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if lbl_ag_print.is_tz_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT') then
 if trunc(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.eff_date) < trunc(v_sysdate) then
 show_error('8044');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if :system.record_status in ('CHANGED') then
 t_eff_date := get_item_property('LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.eff_date', database_value);
 if t_eff_date != :LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.eff_date then
 if trunc(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.eff_date) < trunc(v_sysdate) then
 show_error('8044');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if :LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.term_date is not null then
 if trunc(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.term_date) < trunc(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.eff_date) then
 show_error('8052');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if; 
 END validate_eff_date;
 
 
 PROCEDURE VALIDATE_TERM_DATE IS
 v_sysdate date;
 t_term_date date;
 begin

 default_value(null, 'global.error_count');
 :global.error_count := 'N'; -- This is used in the on-error trigger

 
 if lbl_ag_print.is_tz_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 

 if :system.record_status in ('CHANGED') then
 t_term_date := get_item_property('LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.term_date', database_value);
 if nvl(t_term_date, sysdate+1000) != nvl(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.term_date, sysdate+1000) then
 if trunc(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.term_date) < trunc(v_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;

 
 if :LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.term_date is not null then
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT') then 
 if trunc(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.term_date) < trunc(v_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if; 
 
 if trunc(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.term_date) < trunc(:LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.eff_date) then
 show_error('8052');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 END validate_term_date;
 
 PROCEDURE clear_form(item_in IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL) IS
 BEGIN
 if item_in = 'S_PRODUCT_TYPE' THEN
 clear_block(no_validate);
 GO_BLOCK('LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_item('ctrl_blk_6.s_product_type');
 set_block_property('LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES', insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES', update_allowed, property_false);
 else
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_item('LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES.product_type');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_6.s_product_type', enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_6.s_product_type', navigable, property_true);
 go_item('ctrl_blk_6.s_product_type');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 set_block_property('LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES', insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('LBL_AG_PRINT_PROD_TYPES', update_allowed, property_false);
 end if;

 lbl_ag_print.init;

 END clear_form;
 
 PROCEDURE init IS
 BEGIN
 :ctrl_blk_6.s_product_type := NULL;
 
 lbl_ag_print.is_tz_enabled := is_timezone_enabled;
 
 IF lbl_ag_print.is_tz_enabled THEN
 :ctrl_blk_6.chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk_6.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 END;
END;
